data.title: 佐天泪子 · 夏夜凉席边的风铃浅憩
data.description: 祭典归来的闷热夏夜里，两人并排仰躺在老式和室的蔺草凉席上。电风扇吱呀转动，屋檐下的玻璃风铃清脆作响。泪子的藤紫浴衣衣领微敞，露出光洁优美的锁骨。她侧过头看着近在咫尺的侧脸，悄悄伸出手指勾住了对方的衣角，嘴角浮现满足安详的微笑。
data.location: traditional tatami room with open sliding doors
data.action: lying side-by-side on tatami, yukata slightly loose, holding finger
data.lighting: pale moonlight and soft paper screen shadows
data.promptProse: Lying side-by-side on cool woven tatami mats on a warm summer night, Saten Ruiko relaxes in her purple floral yukata. Her collar rests comfortably open as she quietly hooks her pinky finger with the viewer's, listening to the gentle chime of a glass wind chime.
data.animaCaption: Ruiko lying comfortably on tatami holding fingers on a summer night.
